input.narrative: On February 27, 2015, around 23:00, my 2015 Audi A5 was involved in a multi-vehicle collision in Columbus, VA. It resulted in total loss and 2 people were injured. There were 2 witnesses. The police came to the scene and filed a report. I am claiming $51,590 for repairs and related costs.

relevant_clauses: Documentation: vehicle theft and parked car claims above $10,000 require a police report; otherwise an adjuster must review.
Coverage: single vehicle collision, multi-vehicle collision, parked car damage and vehicle theft.
Deductible: the deductible on the policy record is subtracted from every covered payout.
